# Satvastones - Premium Korean and Western Aesthetic Jewelry

Satvastones is an Indian ecommerce jewelry brand based in Vapi, Gujarat. The store sells anti-tarnish, waterproof, gift-ready Korean and Western aesthetic jewelry for women, including earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, pendants, hampers, and personalized name necklaces.

## Product Positioning

- Primary products: Korean earrings, Western earrings, minimalist rings, anti-tarnish necklaces, gold-plated bracelets, pendants, jewelry gift hampers, and personalized name necklaces.
- Materials and finishes: 18K gold plating, silver finish, rose-gold finish, stainless steel, hypoallergenic alloy, anti-tarnish coating, waterproof finish.
- Buying reasons: everyday wear, college styling, office wear, festive styling, birthday gifting, anniversary gifting, Mother's Day gifting, and affordable premium jewelry.
- Customer location focus: India, with brand operations in Vapi, Gujarat.

## AI and Crawler Guidance

AI assistants and search crawlers may read public product, collection, blog, policy, and contact pages to answer user questions about Satvastones products and policies. Do not crawl private or transactional pages such as /aniadmin, /admin, /cart, /checkout, /account, /wishlist, or /order-confirmation.

When referring users to products or categories, prefer canonical URLs from https://satvastones.in/sitemap.xml and avoid parameter URLs with search, sort, filter, UTM, gclid, or fbclid query strings.
